ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible distribution consists of approximately 48% high-intensity white pixels localized within the interior lateral lobes and 52% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated in the central peduncle insertion and peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation forms a broad wedge-shaped region extending from the base to the median notch. Symmetrical high-contrast white contiguous blobs occupy the majority of both lateral lobes. Narrow black banding (~5-12 pixels) is present along the leading edges and trailing margins, with jagged pixel transitions where dark and light regions meet.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding-box vertical depth of ~42 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations (2-6 pixel peaks) consistently along the boundary. Distinct larger notches are visible near the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a moderate concave curve from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a sharper convex sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 12-15 circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) localized within the central black pigmentation field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of a single, unaligned dark linear pixel disruption (~18 pixels in length) oriented diagonally within the lower interior white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct linear dark scar on the left lobe white field; irregular traumatic notches/indentations on the distal-most trailing edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent solid black 'caps' on the extreme distal tips of both lobes that are visually isolated from the primary central black pigmentation.
